title: Choose the homepage composition
question: All three use the confirmed Analyst’s Working Paper identity. Pick the composition I should build.

options.label: Working Paper
options.lineage: financial research workbook + annotated model printout
options.thesis: The finance app is the evidence; Marc’s point of view is written in its margins.
options.viewport: Thesis left, dominant annotated app figure center, GitHub evidence rail right.
options.risk: The three-column opening asks the mobile adaptation to be especially disciplined.

options.label: Evidence Workbench
options.lineage: equity-research tear sheet + developer inspection bench
options.thesis: One oversized product specimen becomes a workbench where finance and code are inspected together.
options.viewport: Compact thesis band above a near-full-width app workbench; GitHub activity is pinned to its edge.
options.risk: The product specimen must remain readable without feeling like a dashboard screenshot.

options.label: Activity Ledger
options.lineage: engineering lab book + market activity ledger
options.thesis: Marc’s public making becomes the page’s continuous record, with the finance app filed as the lead case.
options.viewport: A horizontal GitHub activity ledger cuts through the hero; the finance app dossier overlaps below.
options.risk: The activity grid must support the story without overpowering the project itself.
